snippet.title: Boxed In Trailer
snippet.description:
This is Boxed In!!

It's a game me and a friend made for the Xbox live Indie Games Marketplace. It's available for purchase now!!!

It has 4 player co-op, I swear!! but I only have one controller to record with at the moment.

Enjoy!
